# Kessel 1.0.0
Kessel 1.0 is a light Windows browser with the features of Opera GX, built-in blocking in the style of Brave, and the looks to match. It runs on WebView2, the Chromium engine already built into Windows 10 and 11, so it doesn't bundle a second copy of Chromium, and tabs you aren't using go to sleep.

Everything stays on your PC: there's no Kessel account, no Kessel server and no telemetry. **93%** of the 1,045 features in [FEATURES.md](https://github.com/puss-in-boots-org/kessel-browser/blob/main/FEATURES.md) are done; the rest are mostly ones WebView2 doesn't allow, or ones that would need an online account (such as sync). New to Kessel? Press **F1** for the guide, or read it [online](https://github.com/puss-in-boots-org/kessel-browser/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md).

## Kessel next to other browsers

| Built in, without an extension | Kessel | Chrome | Edge | Firefox | Brave | Opera GX | Vivaldi |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Blocks ads (not just trackers) | ✅ | – | – ¹ | – ¹ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Randomizes your fingerprint (canvas, audio, WebGL…) | ✅ | – | – | partly ² | ✅ | – | – |
| VPN | ✅ ³ | – | limited ⁴ | free, 50 GB/month ⁵ | paid | free | free tier ⁶ |
| No account for anything, no telemetry | ✅ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| Command palette with every command | ✅ | – | – | – | – | – | ✅ |
| Mouse gestures | ✅ | – | ✅ | – | – | ✅ | ✅ |
| Workspaces (separate sets of tabs) | ✅ | – | ✅ ⁷ | – | – | ✅ | ✅ |
| Feed reader | ✅ | – | – | – | – | – | ✅ |
| Watch a page for changes | ✅ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| Browser lock (PIN, password, Windows Hello) | ✅ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| Engine | Windows' own WebView2 | own Chromium | Chromium | Gecko | own Chromium | own Chromium | own Chromium |

1. Edge and Firefox block trackers by default, but not ads.
2. Firefox's fingerprinting protection blocks known fingerprinting scripts, and its full resistance mode is opt-in.
3. **Kessel's VPN is WireGuard, run by Kessel itself.** Import any provider's WireGuard configs, or enter your Surfshark key to get every Surfshark location. SOCKS5 and HTTP servers work too. There's no data cap beyond your provider's, no DNS leaks, and nothing goes around it when the server is down.
4. Edge Secure Network: 5 GB a month where Microsoft offers it.
5. Firefox 149+: browser traffic only, in the countries Mozilla has launched it in.
6. Vivaldi: Proton VPN's free tier, which needs an account.
7. Edge Workspaces live in Microsoft's cloud and need a Microsoft account.

*The other browsers are described as of October 2026, from their own published features. They change often; corrections are welcome.*

## Everything Kessel offers

### Light by design
- **Tabs have a lifecycle:** shown, then hidden (throttled), then paused, then asleep. A sleeping tab frees its memory and wakes when you come back. Tabs playing sound, and sites you list, are left alone.
- **Energy saver:** on battery, or always.
- **A task manager:** `Shift+Esc` shows each page's process with its memory and CPU.
- **Hover cards** show each tab's memory, CPU and a preview.

### Tabs, windows and workspaces
- **Tab groups:** named and coloured, fold into their label, saved to the bookmarks bar, grouped by site automatically.
- **Tab layout:** pinned tabs; vertical tabs (resizable, collapsible to icons); multi-select; tab search across every window (`Ctrl+Shift+A`).
- **Moving tabs:** drag tabs between windows without reloading; pop-out windows; split view.
- **Workspaces:** each with its own tabs, icon and colour. Their tabs sleep while you're elsewhere.
- **Accounts:** sign in to the same site as several people at once.
- **Profiles:** separate Kessels with their own desktop shortcuts.
- **Sessions:** saved sessions, named windows, and restore after a crash.

### A smart address bar
- **Suggestions:** history, bookmarks, open tabs and your search engine, with in-place completion.
- **Answers:** sums, unit and currency conversion, definitions, the time anywhere, passwords and UUIDs.
- **Commands** by name; search keywords (`yt cats`); your own search engines; sites' own engines in one click.
- **Command palette (`F2`)** with every command; command chains.

### Shields
- **Blocking:** Brave's adblock-rust engine with EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock Origin's lists and scriptlets, plus your own lists. Cosmetic filtering; hide any element for good.
- **Clean connections:** HTTPS upgrade, tracking codes stripped from links, click-tracking redirects skipped, AMP skipped.
- **Fingerprint randomization:** canvas, audio, WebGL, CPU cores and screen size.
- **Privacy dashboard:** what was blocked, day by day and per site, and every connection Kessel itself makes.

### Privacy
- **Cookies:** third-party cookies blocked (partitioned ones kept); a cookie viewer and editor; per-site rules (allow, until Kessel closes, or block); maximum cookie age.
- **Sending less:** Global Privacy Control, an optional Do Not Track, referrer and user-agent controls, and an opt-in UTC time zone.
- **Forgetting:** private windows; forget chosen sites when their last tab closes; clear everything when Kessel closes.

### Security
- **Dangerous sites:** malware, phishing and badware lists checked on this PC (nothing is sent anywhere), with warning pages. Microsoft SmartScreen is opt-in.
- **Connections:** HTTPS-only mode; clear certificate warnings and a certificate viewer.
- **Downloads:** risky ones wait for you to keep or discard them.
- **Lock Kessel** with a PIN, a password or Windows Hello: when it starts, after you've been away, or private windows only.

### VPN and network
- **WireGuard VPN:** your own provider's configs, or every Surfshark location with your key. SOCKS5/HTTP servers too.
- **Secure DNS:** DNS over HTTPS or TLS, with Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 or your own server.
- **Proxies:** your own proxy or a PAC script, plus per-site proxies (or straight past the VPN).

### Passwords and forms
- **The vault:** behind your master password (Argon2id, AES-256-GCM), with optional TOTP. It offers to save as you sign in, and a chip fills the login in on its own site.
- **Password health:** weak and reused passwords flagged. The breach check is opt-in and sends only 5 characters of each hash.
- **Passkeys and security keys** through Windows Hello.
- **Addresses and cards** from a list only you see. Cards are encrypted for your Windows account, and security codes are never kept.

### Reading and research
- **Reading:**
  - Reader view (`F9`) that reads aloud.
  - A reading list that keeps pages for offline reading.
  - Highlights and notes on any page.
- **Writing:**
  - Spell check with Windows' own dictionaries (on this PC).
  - Optional grammar checking with LanguageTool.
- **Language:**
  - A translate chip, with Always and Never rules.
  - Define a word.
  - Search for selected text, or for an image.
- **PDF viewer:** thumbnails, search, highlight, draw, add text and pictures, fill in forms, sign, and present full screen.
- **Keeping up:** feeds (RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, OPML); watch any page for changes; peek at a link in a small window; full-text history search (opt-in).

### Side panel
- **Built-in panels:** bookmarks, history, reading list, notes, search across everything, and extensions.
- **Pinned sites** in the panel.
- **An AI assistant** of your choice (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, Le Chat or your own). Right-click → Ask AI about this.

### Media and capture
- **Media controls** for every tab: play, pause, seek, speed, captions and audio tracks.
- **Video:** picture-in-picture (`Alt+P`), theater mode, and your own subtitle style.
- **Screenshots:** what's in view, the whole page or a part, with an editor (pen, arrows, text, blur, crop).
- **Sharing:** a QR code, a Markdown link, or Windows' Share window.

### Apps, extensions and downloads
- **Install a site as an app:** Start menu, its own window, badges, jump-list shortcuts, file and protocol handling.
- **Extensions:** add from the Chrome Web Store and Edge Add-ons; per-site access; automatic updates; developer mode.
- **Notifications:** Kessel's own cards, stacked per site, with a history.
- **Downloads:** pause, resume, retry, search and sort; ask where to save; sort into folders by kind.

### Make it yours
- **Looks:** 11 styles (Liquid Glass, Hyper Clean, Futuristic and more), each with about 150 options, plus wallpapers and Chrome themes' colours.
- **Layout:** compact and touch density; toolbar buttons you can hide and move; your own CSS and colour filters per site.
- **Controls:** every shortcut can be changed; mouse gestures.
- **Accessibility:** text size, a minimum font size, your fonts, less motion, focus outlines, caret browsing and colour filters.

### When something goes wrong
- **Crash recovery:** crashed tabs reload in a click; if the engine itself goes, Kessel restarts with your tabs.
- **Safe mode:** no extensions and no graphics card, used automatically after two failed starts.
- **Damaged settings files** are replaced from their backup.
- **Diagnostics:** `kessel://diagnostics` and `kessel://gpu`, each with a report to copy.

### Moving in and out
- **Import from Opera GX, Opera, Brave, Chrome, Edge, Vivaldi and Firefox:** bookmarks, history, open tabs, cookies, passwords and extensions.
- **Export:** bookmarks, history, passwords, open tabs and settings.

### Kessel for phones
- An Android app (below) with the same Shields, a bottom address bar and a tab grid.

## New since 0.10.0
- **VPN:** WireGuard run by Kessel itself, Surfshark's locations with your key, secure DNS and per-site proxies.
- **Kessel's own notifications, PDF viewer, spell check and grammar.**
- **Apps:** installable sites with badges, shortcuts, file handling and protocol handling.
- **Browser lock, accessibility settings, split view and workspaces.**
- **Crash handling, safe mode, the task manager and diagnostics.**
- **More:** per-site settings (JavaScript, images, pop-ups, redirects, sound), the privacy dashboard, full-text history search, offline pages, the translate chip, saved sessions, and address and card autofill.
- **The user guide:** in Help (`F1`), and as [docs/GUIDE.md](https://github.com/puss-in-boots-org/kessel-browser/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md).
- **Security hardening:**
  - A website's `file://` links no longer open.
  - Passwords aren't filled in over plain http, except on your own network.
  - A login is offered only on its own site and that site's subdomains.
  - Local websites are treated as websites (with Shields and history).

## What Kessel leaves out
- **Sync:** it would need an online account and a server, and Kessel has neither by design. Use import and export instead.
- **Its own copy of Chromium:** web compatibility, codecs and DevTools come from WebView2, which Windows keeps up to date.

## Downloads
- **Windows:**
  - `Kessel_1.0.0_x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Kessel_1.0.0_x64_en-US.msi`.
  - The installers aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen asks before running them.
- **Android:** `Kessel_1.0.0_android.apk` (install directly) or `Kessel_1.0.0_android.aab` (Play Store bundle).
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
